detail.longDescription: So you want to close the loop between LinkedIn Ads and your CRM. Great! But now you have to convince your team. Most marketing teams already know their attribution has gaps. But often that's where the conversation stalls. Try standing in front of them and explaining why the fix involves a word like "integration," and watch eyes glaze over before you've even made the ask.
